{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
sales_df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Convert revenue from string to float, handling the thousands separators
sales_df['revenue'] = sales_df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Filter out refunded orders
sales_df = sales_df[sales_df['status'] == 'completed']

# Stratify by customer_segment and compute average revenue per channel within each segment
# This adjusts for the confounding by customer segment
channel_segment_revenue = sales_df.groupby(['channel', 'customer_segment'], as_index=False)['revenue'].mean()

# Compute the average revenue per channel across all segments (weighted by segment size)
# This gives a fairer comparison that accounts for the imbalance
channel_avg_revenue = channel_segment_revenue.groupby('channel', as_index=False)['revenue'].mean()

# Output the result
channel_avg_revenue"}
